title: Recognizing a Limit of Riemann Sums as a Definite Integral
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Express the limit lim_{n -> oo} sum_{k=1}^n (1 + 3k/n)^4 (3/n) as a definite integral and find its exact value.

steps.title: Identify Subinterval Width and Sample Points
steps.mathExpression: \Delta x = \frac{3}{n} = \frac{b - a}{n} \implies b - a = 3; \quad c_k = 1 + \frac{3k}{n} \implies a = 1, \; b = 4
steps.explanation: Match terms with definition c_k = a + k Delta x.

steps.title: Identify Integrand Function
steps.explanation: The expression inside the 4th power corresponds to x.
steps.why: Mapping sample point function to integrand.
